user.title: Homeray
user.description: Adds the checks that the Homeray cards cannot do on their own: devices that went silent, every kind of battery sensor, and your home network for the map. It only reads Home Assistant's own data.

data_description.silent_hours: A device that still looks available but has sent nothing for this long is listed as silent.
data_description.silent_scope: Battery devices are the ones that usually die without warning.
data_description.battery_threshold: Percentage sensors below this value count as low.
data_description.ignore_rechargeable: Leaves out phones and devices with a charging or storage sensor, whose low level is normal.
data_description.exclude_label: The same label used by the Homeray issues card (label ID).
